title: PZ run
description: One run on the route-time axis (00:00:00 = route start)

list.name: run
list.label: run
list.definition: SELECT run FROM runs ORDER BY started DESC
list.query: SELECT run FROM runs ORDER BY started DESC

list.name: source
list.label: profiler
list.definition: SELECT source FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM stacks WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}) s ORDER BY CASE source WHEN 'game' THEN 0 WHEN 'asprof' THEN 1 WHEN 'jfr' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
list.query: SELECT source FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM stacks WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}) s ORDER BY CASE source WHEN 'game' THEN 0 WHEN 'asprof' THEN 1 WHEN 'jfr' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

list.name: thread
list.label: threads
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT thread FROM stacks WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT thread FROM stacks WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

target.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, key AS text FROM series WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = 'mark' AND key NOT LIKE 'route-%' AND $__timeFilter(rt)

SELECT timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AS time, 'route start' AS text UNION ALL SELECT timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => route_seconds), 'route end' FROM runs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND route_seconds IS NOT NULL

targets.rawSql: SELECT p50_ms AS p50, p99_ms AS p99, p99_9_ms AS "p99.9", max_ms AS max FROM runs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}
SELECT fps_mean AS fps, fps_1pct_low AS "1% low", over_33ms AS ">33 ms", jitter_ms AS "jitter ms" FROM runs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}
SELECT cpu_pct AS CPU, busiest_core_pct AS "busiest core", gpu_pct AS GPU, game_thread_pct AS "game thread", render_thread_pct AS "render thread" FROM runs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}

SELECT coalesce(verdict, '-') AS "Jev", CASE
  WHEN gpu_pct >= 90 THEN 'GPU-bound'
  WHEN game_thread_pct >= 90 OR game_load_pct >= 90 THEN 'game thread'
  WHEN fps_mean >= 235 AND props NOT LIKE '%uncappedFps=true%' THEN 'at 240 cap'
  WHEN fps_mean IS NULL THEN NULL
  ELSE 'headroom left' END AS bound, CASE WHEN valid THEN 'valid' ELSE 'INVALID' END AS route, variant FROM runs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}
SELECT chunk_p99_ms AS "chunk p99 ms", chunks_per_s AS "chunks/s", gc_events AS "GC pauses", gc_max_ms AS "worst GC ms" FROM runs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}
SELECT gpu_ms_mean AS "GPU ms/frame", gpu_w AS watts, gpu_c AS "°C", vram_mib AS "VRAM MiB" FROM runs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}

SELECT k AS fact, v AS value FROM runs, LATERAL (VALUES
  ('started', to_char(started, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), ('machine', machine), ('platform', platform), ('mode', mode), ('preset', preset),
  ('route', route), ('zoom', zoom), ('resolution', resolution), ('opengl', opengl), ('jvm', jvm), ('launcher', launcher),
  ('variant', variant), ('props', props), ('flags', flags), ('route seconds', round(route_seconds::numeric, 2)::text),
  ('zombies loaded', zombies_loaded::text), ('verdict', verdict || ' (' || round(verdict_confidence::numeric, 2) || ')'), ('path', path)
) AS x(k, v) WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND v IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Frame time (x = route time, 00:00:00 = route start)
Every frame
panels.description: game frame = pzopt-frames.out, presented = the overlay's presented frame, GPU = GL timer query per frame. Dashed: 4.17 (240 fps), 10 (p99 target), 16.7 ms (p99.9 target).

targets.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, ms AS "game frame" FROM frames WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT rt AS time, ms AS "presented" FROM overlay WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT rt AS time, ms AS "GPU" FROM (SELECT rt, gpu_ms AS ms FROM overlay WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt)) x ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS p50,
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS p99, max(ms) AS max
FROM frames WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, count(*) / nullif(sum(ms) / 1000, 0) AS fps, min(1000 / nullif(ms, 0)) AS "slowest frame as fps"
FROM frames WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ms AS "frame ms" FROM frames x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9))

SELECT 'game frame' AS source, count(*) AS frames,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS p90,
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS p99, percentile_cont(0.999) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "p99.9",
  max(ms) AS max, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ms > 16.7) AS ">16.7", count(*) FILTER (WHERE ms > 33.3) AS ">33.3", stddev(ms) AS stdev
FROM frames x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'presented', count(*), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms), percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms),
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms), percentile_cont(0.999) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms), max(ms),
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE ms > 16.7), count(*) FILTER (WHERE ms > 33.3), stddev(ms)
FROM overlay x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'GPU time', count(*), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gpu_ms), percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gpu_ms),
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gpu_ms), percentile_cont(0.999) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gpu_ms), max(gpu_ms),
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE gpu_ms > 16.7), count(*) FILTER (WHERE gpu_ms > 33.3), stddev(gpu_ms)
FROM overlay x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'flip interval', count(*), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY interval_ms), percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY interval_ms),
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY interval_ms), percentile_cont(0.999) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY interval_ms), max(interval_ms),
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE interval_ms > 16.7), count(*) FILTER (WHERE interval_ms > 33.3), stddev(interval_ms)
FROM present x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9))

SELECT rt AS time, cpu_pct AS "CPU", busiest_core_pct AS "busiest core", gpu_pct AS "GPU"
FROM sysmon WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Threads (overlay, per frame)
panels.description: 100 ms means of the overlay's own load columns

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) + (extract(milliseconds FROM rt)::int / 100) * interval '100 ms' AS time,
  avg(game_load) AS "game thread", avg(render_load) AS "render thread", avg(gpu_load) AS "GPU", avg(cpu_load) AS "CPU"
FROM overlay WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT rt AS time, game_cpu_pct / 100 AS "game process cores", gpu_w AS "GPU W", gpu_c AS "GPU °C"
FROM sysmon WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

SELECT rt AS time, gpu_sm_mhz AS "SM MHz", gpu_mem_mhz AS "memory MHz", vram_mib AS "VRAM MiB"
FROM sysmon WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT thread, cpu_ms AS "CPU ms", share * 100 AS "% of wall" FROM threads WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Power (route mean)
panels.description: The run's best power source over the route window: sysmon (harness), else the game's pzopt-power.out, else macpower. total = battery on battery, else CPU package (RAPL) or APU socket + discrete GPU; empty without a CPU reading (scripts/power-access.sh).

targets.rawSql: SELECT total_w AS "total W", cpu_w AS "CPU W", gpu_w AS "GPU W", j_per_frame AS "J/frame", power_source AS source FROM runs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring}

panels.title: Power (sysmon, every 0.5 s)
panels.description: harness/sysmon.sh: CPU package from RAPL, GPU from nvidia-smi / amdgpu hwmon, battery discharge, total as in the stat

targets.rawSql:
SELECT rt AS time, total_w AS "total", cpu_w AS "CPU package", soc_w AS "APU socket", gpu_w AS "GPU", bat_w AS "battery"
FROM sysmon WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Power (in game / macpower)
panels.description: game = pzopt.Power (the overlay's power line, pzopt-power.out); mac = harness/macpower.py (total = the SMC's whole-system load, display included)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT rt AS time, source || ' total' AS metric, total_w AS value FROM power WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND total_w IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(rt)
UNION ALL SELECT rt, source || ' CPU', cpu_w FROM power WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND cpu_w IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(rt)
UNION ALL SELECT rt, source || ' APU socket', soc_w FROM power WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND soc_w IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(rt)
UNION ALL SELECT rt, source || ' GPU', gpu_w FROM power WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND gpu_w IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(rt)
UNION ALL SELECT rt, source || ' battery', bat_w FROM power WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND bat_w IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy per frame (per second)
panels.description: total watts / frames per second in each second

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS s, avg(total_w) AS w FROM sysmon WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND total_w IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1),
     f AS (SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS s, count(*) / nullif(sum(ms) / 1000, 0) AS fps FROM frames WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT w.s AS time, w.w / nullif(f.fps, 0) AS "J/frame (sysmon)" FROM w JOIN f USING (s) ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, avg(total_w) / nullif(avg(fps), 0) AS "J/frame (in game)"
FROM power WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = 'game' AND total_w IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Game thread (pzopt-gamethread.out, share of stack samples)

targets.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, name AS metric, share * 100 AS value FROM gamethread WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 'p' AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

WITH top AS (SELECT name FROM gamethread x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 's' AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9)) GROUP BY name ORDER BY sum(samples) DESC LIMIT 12)
SELECT rt AS time, name AS metric, share * 100 AS value FROM gamethread WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 's' AND name IN (SELECT name FROM top) AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

SELECT name, sum(samples) AS samples, 100.0 * sum(samples) / nullif((SELECT sum(samples) FROM gamethread x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 'total' AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9))), 0) AS share
FROM gamethread x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 's' AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9)) GROUP BY name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT name, sum(samples) AS samples, 100.0 * sum(samples) / nullif((SELECT sum(samples) FROM gamethread x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 'total' AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9))), 0) AS share
FROM gamethread x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 'l' AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9)) GROUP BY name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT name, sum(samples) AS samples, 100.0 * sum(samples) / nullif((SELECT sum(samples) FROM gamethread x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 'total' AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9))), 0) AS share
FROM gamethread x WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND kind = 'w' AND rt >= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND rt <= timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' + make_interval(secs => coalesce((SELECT route_seconds FROM runs r WHERE r.run = x.run), 1e9)) GROUP BY name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Chunk latency (enqueue → publish, one point per chunk)

targets.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, total_ms AS "total" FROM chunks WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, avg(queue_wait_ms) AS "queue wait", avg(load_ms) AS load, avg(recalc_wait_ms) AS "recalc wait",
  avg(recalc_ms) AS recalc, avg(publish_wait_ms) AS "publish wait", count(*) AS "chunks/s"
FROM chunks WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT rt AS time, pause_ms AS "pause" FROM gc WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Flip interval on screen (X Present)
panels.description: present.txt: time between the game window's flips

targets.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, interval_ms AS "flip interval" FROM present WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT rt AS time, key AS metric, value FROM series WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = 'drive' AND key IN ('kmh', 'target_kmh') AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

SELECT rt AS time, key AS metric, value FROM series WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = 'drive' AND key IN ('xte', 'hdg_err', 'steer', 'brake', 'offset', 'obstacles', 'chunk_ahead') AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Profiler: flame graph (pick the source and threads above; drag across any time panel to narrow the window)
Flame graph: $source, $thread
panels.description: game = the in-game profiler's game-thread stacks (pzopt-stacks.out, 25-100 Hz); lua = the Lua profile (pzopt-lua.out); jfr = --jfr (pzopt.jfr, Java threads); asprof = --asprof (asprof.jfr, every thread with native frames). Root 'all' = every sample in the window; the top table beside it ranks self and total time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH a AS (SELECT stack_id, sum(samples) AS c FROM stacks WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND thread IN (${thread:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1),
f AS (SELECT d.frames, a.c FROM a JOIN stack_defs d ON d.id = a.stack_id),
n AS (SELECT f.frames[1:i] AS path, sum(f.c) AS value, sum(f.c) FILTER (WHERE i = cardinality(f.frames)) AS self
      FROM f, generate_series(0, cardinality(f.frames)) AS i GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cardinality(path) AS level, value, coalesce(self, 0) AS self, coalesce(path[cardinality(path)], 'all') AS label FROM n ORDER BY path

SELECT date_trunc('second', rt) AS time, thread AS metric, sum(samples) AS value FROM stacks WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND thread IN (${thread:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(rt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT rt AS time, thread AS metric, cpu_pct AS value FROM sched WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND thread IN (SELECT thread FROM sched WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} GROUP BY thread ORDER BY sum(cpu_pct) DESC LIMIT 12) AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Run-queue wait per OS thread (runnable, no CPU)

targets.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, thread AS metric, runq_pct AS value FROM sched WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND thread IN (SELECT thread FROM sched WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} GROUP BY thread ORDER BY sum(cpu_pct) DESC LIMIT 12) AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT rt AS time, key AS metric, value FROM series WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = 'psi' AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT rt AS time, key AS metric, value FROM series WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND source = 'mem' AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Frame pacing (pzopt-pacing.out)
panels.description: sim step = game-frame interval; acquire lag = game frame done -> render thread took it; swap = the swap call; hold = presentPacing's wait; GPU after swap; shown after swap (Mac).

targets.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, sim_step_ms AS "sim step", acquire_lag_ms AS "acquire lag", swap_ms AS swap, hold_ms AS hold, gpu_after_swap_ms AS "GPU after swap", shown_after_swap_ms AS "shown after swap" FROM pacing WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Inputs sent to the game (pzopt-input.out: every key / mouse / pad change the game thread saw)
Keys and buttons
panels.description: Green = held. Every source counts: a real keyboard / mouse / pad, uinput (pad.py, inputlag-drive.py), xdotool, the in-game VirtualPad.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, device || ' ' || control AS metric, value FROM inputs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND control NOT IN ('x', 'y', 'wheel', 'lx', 'ly', 'rx', 'ry', 'lt', 'rt', 'hat') AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT rt AS time, device || ' ' || control AS metric, value FROM inputs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND control IN ('x', 'y', 'lx', 'ly', 'rx', 'ry', 'lt', 'rt') AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT rt AS time, device || ' ' || control AS metric, value FROM inputs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND control IN ('wheel', 'hat') AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY 1
SELECT round(rel_s::numeric, 3) AS "s from route start", device, control, value FROM inputs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) ORDER BY rt LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Configured by the harness (flags, props, options, env, vmargs, mods, run.opts)

targets.rawSql: SELECT kind, key, value FROM run_inputs WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY CASE kind WHEN 'flag' THEN 0 WHEN 'prop' THEN 1 WHEN 'option' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, kind, key

panels.title: Console (pzopt-loadtrace.out: every console line with its epoch)
Console
panels.description: Filter with the 'console search' box at the top; the time range applies (widen it to see the boot and load).

targets.rawSql: SELECT rt AS time, category || '  ' || text AS body, CASE WHEN level ILIKE 'err%' THEN 'error' WHEN level ILIKE 'warn%' THEN 'warning' ELSE 'info' END AS level FROM events WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(rt) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR text ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%') ORDER BY rt LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Counters (pzopt-bench.out, bake / batch counters, chunk stats)

targets.rawSql: SELECT grp AS group, key, value FROM counters WHERE run = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY grp, key
